facts.title: chard and white bean stew
ingredients: 1 pound Swiss chard (can also swap kale, spinach or another green), ribs and stems removed and cleaned
1 cup (4 1/4 ounces) chopped shallots, about 4 medium
2 15-ounce cans (or about 3 3/4 cups) white beans, drained and rinsed
2 cups (or more to taste) vegetable broth
1 cup pureed tomatoes (from a can/carton/your jarred summer supply)
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
facts.author: Deb Perelman
